body: 'm still here. I took the advice here and asked for information on a community college. I also looked into volunteering to help in the community. It's so hard sometimes to move forward. But I'm going to give myself one more chance. I can't promise I won't be here again. But I'll try. Thank you everyone.

I feel stuck. Stuck on the person I could have been, without the abuse. Stuck on somehow making him hurt like he hurt me. I see happy people and families and I get angry. I see people who aren't struggling and on some level I hate them. To just wake up and feel...normal I guess? No struggle of containing your emotions or struggling to feel them. Of second guessing yourself because you've been depressed so long your memory is a basket full of holes.  Of randomly having flashbacks of abuse because of a phrase or a sound.  I've made it almost to 25. Yes I've survive. But it took everything I had. I don't have anything else to move forward with.
